name: Higgsfield
inspiration: Higgsfield creator-tutorial videos (Ultra-Realistic AI Ads / Faceless Channel / Viral AI Short Film). Neon-lime accent over three canvases (near-black navy, dark-olive dot-matrix, butter cream), frosted-glass panels floating in perspective beside the speaker, staged grey-to-lime text reveals, LED boot cards, kinetic cream typography montages. Reference frames in references/.
summary: The AI-tool creator style. Use for tool tutorials, workflow walkthroughs, and tech-forward content where graphics should feel like the product UI escaped into the room.

palette.notes: Lime #D6FD03 (sampled from refs) is the ONLY saturated color. Three takeover canvases exactly: navy, olive, cream. Mirrored in tokens.css.

fonts.notes: Inter Tight 800/900 ALL CAPS is the display voice. JetBrains Mono for pills, tags, eyebrow sublabels. Inter for rare supporting copy.

motion: Two speeds: SNAP (text reveals + panel entrances, expo.out ~0.45s; pops back.out(1.9)) and DRIFT (glass panels float sine.inOut ~6s while alive; text never drifts). Signature: the grey-to-lime flip - text enters at rgba(255,255,255,0.38) and snaps to white/lime as the next element lands, always staged, never simultaneous. Stage titles resolve via seeded dot-matrix shimmer.
transitions: Elements snap in and out (slide + fade, --dur-out); takeovers hard-cut against footage. Graphics persist across camera-angle cuts and re-anchor.

cards.notes: The match-cut bridge: a lime prop flies across frame, the scene hard-swaps under it at center crossing. Cut hidden by the moving object.
Talking-head punch-in as jump cut: instant scale steps (1.00/1.07/1.14), then a hard cut back to rest. No easing, no blur.
Tilted frosted-glass pane whips across L-to-R, scene swaps at the covered midpoint. Same glass as tier2 panels, lime leading edge.
Lime-rimmed media panel slides in from frame-right (expo.out), drifts while alive, slides back out. The base scene never cuts, the panel IS the b-roll.
Olive LED-dot shutter resolves on with a lime glow pulse, scene swaps behind, shutter dissolves. The chapter turn between sections.
Camera dives into an anchored glass panel until it becomes the next scene; scene A parallax-falls behind. One continuous zoom, cut invisible at full cover.
Camera whips left as one world: both scenes travel together, blur peaks mid-move, B lands with a 30px overshoot settle.
Rotational whip: -9deg + scale punch + blur out of A, cut at peak, B un-spins from +9deg to level. Rotation direction carries through the cut.
Crash-zoom to 1.55 with blur and a 1.5deg rotation kiss, cut at peak, B settles from 1.4 to rest.
B pushes A off-left; A retreats at 60% speed under a darkening shade (depth), B overshoots 26px and settles. Lime hairline on the leading edge.
Four vertical slats of B drop in staggered 70ms apart (expo.out) with lime leading edges; real B swaps under full cover, slats dissolve.
B irises open from a click point behind a lime ring that leads the edge and dissolves. Clip-path driven.
Cinematic blink: bars crush closed, meet as a lime hairline flash, swap behind closed lids, reopen on B. Heaviest move; 1-2 uses per video.
A 420px Inter Tight 900 word drives through as the wiper with a motion lean; swap under its center pass.
The speaker PIP grows to full-bleed and becomes the next scene; A dims and scales back behind. Inverse of zoom-through; use leaving screen-share sections.
Three-frame lime-white pop; the cut lands inside the flash, B settles from a 1.06 micro-punch. For rapid montage runs.
